summary: Full authenticated browser QA of CloudBite (Admin, Manager, Customer, Rider) at https://kitchen-staging-3.preview.emergentagent.com. All critical business rules verified end-to-end: 5 KM delivery radius enforced (0.51 km deliverable, 16.86 km blocked and Place Order disabled), Delivery Fee ₹0 / Platform ₹0 / Convenience ₹0 (COD only), unavailable items visible with 'Currently Unavailable' badge and no Add button, customer sees exactly 3 statuses (ORDER BEING PREPARED → ORDER ON THE WAY → ORDER ARRIVED — ALL CAPS, prior title-case bug is FIXED). Order CB1004 placed by qa-customer, admin CONFIRMED then ASSIGNED to QA Rider (QA Rider Inactive was NOT offered in the dropdown — backend correctly filters), rider Accept→Pickup→Start→Delivered progressed and customer tracking page updated stage-by-stage in real time. Staff sidebar NavLink bug from iteration_1 is FIXED (absolute paths, all 12 sidebar destinations navigate to the correct /console/<page>). Settings radius edited via UI from 6→5 and persisted after reload. Protected route /console/orders correctly redirects to login when session cleared. Manager RBAC: sidebar correctly hides 7 admin-only items, admin-API routes (managers/customers/reports/audit) all return 403 on direct URL visit. NO console JS errors observed across any portal (only a benign Radix DialogContent aria-describedby warning). 1 real bug: /app/orders/<invalid-id> stays on 'Loading…' forever instead of showing a not-found state. 1 RBAC-leak: manager can still LOAD /console/menu, /console/categories, /console/settings via direct URL because the pages read from shared endpoints that don't require manage_menu/admin perms — writes are (assumed) blocked backend-side but the UI shouldn't render Add/Edit/Delete controls for a permissionless role.

minor.issue: These endpoints return 200 to a manager account that has neither manage_menu nor admin role, allowing a limited manager to see the full admin Menu / Categories / Settings pages via direct URL. If write endpoints are properly gated, this is a UX leak not a data compromise, but consider requiring 'manage_menu' for admin-view menu listing and admin role for /api/settings GET (or split into /api/admin/settings).

ui_bugs.issue: Visiting /app/orders/000000000000000000000000 (or any non-existent/foreign order id) shows an infinite 'Loading…' spinner. Should render a not-found / access-denied state with a way back to /app/orders.

No client-side route guard for /console/menu, /console/categories, /console/settings. A logged-in manager without manage_menu or admin role can navigate to these pages and see full Menu list + Add Category button + Settings form. Backend GETs return 200 (see backend minor). Recommend a <RequirePerm perm='manage_menu'>/<RequireAdmin> wrapper around these routes and hide write controls when perm absent.

issues: Radix DialogContent console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}'. Cosmetic/a11y — add DialogDescription or aria-describedby.

action_items: Fix /app/orders/:id to render a graceful not-found state when the order id is invalid or doesn't belong to the logged-in customer (currently stuck on Loading…).

Add client-side RBAC guards on /console/menu, /console/categories, /console/settings so a manager without manage_menu/admin cannot open the admin editor pages. Ideally also gate the GETs server-side (or split settings into /api/admin/settings).
Optional: fix Radix DialogContent a11y warning by supplying DialogDescription or aria-describedby on customer FoodDetailSheet.
critical_code_review_comments: PASS — StaffLayout NavLink bug from iteration_1 is fully fixed (absolute `to=/console/<slug>` + end on Dashboard); all 12 sidebar destinations verified.
PASS — Customer OrderTracking 3-stage labels are now proper ALL CAPS (ORDER BEING PREPARED / ORDER ON THE WAY / ORDER ARRIVED).

PASS — Server-side 5 km delivery radius enforcement is visible in the UI: 0.51 km → 'Great! We deliver to your location.', 16.86 km → 'Sorry, we currently deliver within 5 km of our kitchen.' and Place Order button is disabled.
PASS — Delivery fee / Platform fee / Convenience fee all render ₹0; Total equals subtotal; payment is COD only.
PASS — Inactive delivery partners are not returned in the admin assign-partner dropdown (QA Rider Inactive absent).
PASS — Cross-role portal isolation: customer visiting /console or /rider is redirected back to /app; unauthenticated /console/orders bounces to login.

OBS — Manager-role RBAC is enforced only on the write-restricted admin-API endpoints (/api/admin/*). Read endpoints /api/menu, /api/categories, /api/settings are role-agnostic, so a manager without manage_menu can still render the admin management pages by typing the URL. Low-severity leak — flag it.
OBS — /app/orders/:id has no error handler on the fetch: an invalid ObjectId leaves the page in a permanent 'Loading…' state. Wrap the fetch in try/catch and render a NotFound component.

success_rate.frontend: ≈93% (all critical flows PASS; 1 medium UI bug + 1 high RBAC leak)

seed_data_creation: Placed one real COD order CB1004 (Chicken Biryani × 1, ₹199) as qa-customer, delivered end-to-end. Admin Settings radius updated 6 → 5 km via UI (as requested). No new accounts created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend URL is set correctly in /app/frontend/.env. The two remaining issues main agent should fix: (1) /app/orders/:id infinite-Loading on invalid/foreign id — needs try/catch + NotFound state; (2) manager can open /console/menu, /console/categories, /console/settings via direct URL — add RequirePerm wrappers. After main agent fixes, retest just those two flows: log in as qa-manager and hit those three URLs (expect redirect or 'Access denied'), and hit /app/orders/000000000000000000000000 as any customer (expect 'Order not found'). Everything else in the request already PASSES (login/RBAC/menu/cart/checkout/radius/E2E delivery lifecycle/customer 3-stage tracking/inactive rider filtered/COD/₹0 fees).
rca of the issue: (1) OrderTracking.jsx most likely calls api.get(`/orders/${id}`) inside a useEffect and only sets state on success — no `.catch` and no 'not found' UI branch, so the initial `null` state renders 'Loading…' forever. Fix: chain .catch and render a NotFound card when the fetch 404s or errors. (2) StaffApp.jsx routes /menu, /categories, /settings do not wrap children in a permission guard; the sidebar hides them but direct navigation bypasses that. The pages then call GET /api/menu, /api/categories, /api/settings which are role-agnostic (customer + staff share menu/categories; settings is only guarded on POST). Fix: add <RequirePerm perm='manage_menu'>/<RequireAdmin> route wrappers in StaffApp, and consider requiring role=admin for GET /api/settings.
